steps: Identify distinct hospital admissions with at least one heart failure ICD-9 code from diagnoses_icd.
Join those admissions to admissions on hadm_id and count distinct qualifying admissions as the denominator.
Count distinct qualifying admissions with hospital_expire_flag = 1 as the numerator.
Compute 100 * numerator / denominator and return NULL if the denominator is zero.
query_plan.sql:
WITH heart_failure_admissions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.hadm_id
  FROM mimic_iii."diagnoses_icd" AS d
  WHERE d.icd9_code IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
), cohort AS (
  SELECT a.hadm_id,
         a.hospital_expire_flag
  FROM mimic_iii."admissions" AS a
  INNER JOIN heart_failure_admissions AS h
    ON a.hadm_id = h.hadm_id
)
SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT hadm_id) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hospital_expire_flag = 1 THEN hadm_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT hadm_id), 2)
       END AS answer
FROM cohort;
